quote: We proposed to represent such summaries as a set of key points scored according to their relative salience. Such summary aims to provide both textual and quantitative views of the argument data in a concise form.
outputs: key points that summarize pro and con arguments on controversial topics

quote: We consider Precision, Recall and F1 of the positive class, as well as the overall accuracy.
Using the Figure Eight crowd labeling platform, we created gold labels for associating the arguments selected as described in Section 3.1 with key points.
guideline: Annotators were guided to mark all of the key points this argument can be associated with, and if none are relevant, to select the 'None' option.
